summary: Read-only scientific audit of the 80 brainstem records (src/data/structures/midbrain.json 21, pons.json 27, medulla.json 32 including the 5 cerebellum records) against taxonomy.json, levels.json, plates.json, anatomy-manifest.json + the committed GLBs, tracts.json, src/geometry/curves.ts and the 26 syndrome cards. Wrote exactly the two files of the write scope and no data file was touched: docs/audit/v15/brainstem.findings.json (68 findings, 11 keys each: id/area/recordId/field/claimed/expected/verdict/severity/basis/basisKind/suggestedFix/notes; verdicts ok 28 / wrong 11 / suspect 28 / unverifiable-here 1; severities critical 0 / major 6 / minor 62) and docs/audit/v15/brainstem.md (method, verdict x severity summary table matching the JSON exactly, the six major findings, the 28 verified-ok rows, coverage gaps, limits). All six major findings are wrong/major and rest on frozen geometry: nuc-snc.origin3d z=2.5 and nuc-snr.origin3d z=3.5 sit 4.4-4.9 au dorsal of their OWN committed GLBs (z 7.4-9.4 / 7.9-9.7); surf-cn5-exit [7,-8,6] is 6.66 au INSIDE ctx-pons-surface.glb (lateral surface at |x| 17.3-17.9); surf-cn10-exit [5,-34,4.5] is INSIDE the inferior olive's own GLB (ray-parity 1/1/1, 0.39 au from its surface) and surf-cn9-exit rests on the olive so the derived CN IX/X courses in curves.ts run through the olive; tract-medial-lemniscus.levels under-claims 5 levels that the atlas's own plate manifests label. Position tests used bbox/centroid comparison plus a Moller-Trumbore ray-parity inside/outside test on the committed triangle soups; 28 rows are explicit verifications of the brief's checklist (oculomotor ventral to PAG/dorsal to MLF, trochlear caudal to oculomotor, abducens under the facial colliculus, facial nucleus ventrolateral with the genu loop, hypoglossal medial/dorsal to the MLF, inferior olive between pyramid and restiform body, vermis midline + deep nuclei deep and in order, plus the eponym families Weber/Benedikt/Claude/Parinard/one-and-a-half/central Horner/Wallenberg/Déjerine/Millard-Gubler and the SCP/ICP directions). One pattern finding is filed as unverifiable-here (15 records whose levels reach 4.4-12.8 au beyond their own frozen meshes - no fix proposed, because trimming a level set on the strength of a possibly-short mesh would be a false correction). Verified with: npm run validate -> exit 0, 'Validation PASSED - 0 errors, 0 warning(s)'; node -e findings-count check -> 'findings 68' exit 0; a self-consistency script confirming 68 sequential ids (no gaps/dupes), all 11 required keys present on every row, verdict/severity enums respected, and the declared counts block equal to the data; git status confirms docs/audit/ is the only new path and that src/data/structures/{midbrain,pons,medulla}.json were not modified (mtime 9/10, before this session).
